decisions.briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.6% and S&P 500 down 1.2%, putting conditions firmly in risk-off territory. No new candidates are available on the screener, so I'm holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market weakness hit growth and tech-heavy names hardest today, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500 by a wide margin, a pattern typical of risk-off days driven by concerns over valuations or interest rate expectations. No specific company-level news drove this move; it appears to be a broad macro-driven pullback. Without fresh positive catalysts, investors rotated away from higher-beta growth stocks.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍走弱，科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅遠超標普500指數，呈現典型的「風險規避」格局，反映市場對估值或利率前景的憂慮。今日未見明顯個股消息帶動，跌勢主要由宏觀因素驅動。缺乏正面催化劑下，資金從高波動的成長股撤出。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and tech shares and move toward safer holdings, often triggered by economic worries or uncertainty. On these days, it's usually better to hold steady and avoid chasing new trades rather than reacting emotionally.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off) 指投資者普遍拋售成長股、科技股等風險較高的資產,轉向較安全的投資,通常由經濟憂慮或不確定性引發。在這類日子,較穩健的做法是按兵不動,避免情緒化追逐新交易。
